trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to unlock or buy. The official description frames it as the end of the entire run: chapters, collectibles, activities and the 100% completion gold all feed into this one box. Plan the playthrough around the roadmap in this guide — story first, collectibles second, activity grinds third, cleanup last — and the platinum simply ticks itself at the end. Because it depends on everything else, whichever trophy you postpone becomes the platinum's bottleneck, so respect the Stage 1 missable cautions from your very first session.
steps: Finish the story chapters (Stage 1)
Clear the collectible sweeps (Stage 2)
Finish the activity grinds and reach 100% completion (Stage 3)
Tick off whatever remains in cleanup (Stage 4)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay a ghost: no detection from entry to exit. The description draws the line clearly — the robbery must succeed AND you must never be spotted — so this is a stealth exercise, not a smash-and-grab. Learn the store's sightlines on a casual visit first, choose a quiet moment, and take the shortest route to the goods and out. Being detected mid-robbery fails the condition but not the trophy: walk away, let things cool down, and try the same store again clean.
steps: Scout a jewelry store and note staff and sightlines
Enter quietly and take the goods without being seen
Leave undetected to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: A silver for the serious criminal work: rob five bank vaults, and escape after each one. The description pairs the two halves deliberately — cracking the vault is only half the job, and a robbery that ends in cuffs or a wasted screen should not be assumed to count, so every vault needs a getaway that actually gets away. Five separate vaults means five plans: scout the location, the exit route and your escape vehicle before you go in. These are among the most profitable jobs in free roam, so the spree also feeds the laundering and spending totals other trophies are tracking.
steps: Scout a bank vault and plan the escape route
Rob the vault and escape cleanly
Repeat at four more vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: One armoured truck, one escape: rob it and get away. The description asks for a single successful truck robbery with a clean getaway, making this the smaller sibling of the bank vault silver — a single job rather than a spree. Armoured trucks are hardened targets, so bring the firepower or the explosives to open one, grab what spills, and have the escape route chosen before the first shot. Trucks appear in free roam as moving opportunities, so keep an eye out while travelling rather than hunting one specific spawn.
steps: Spot an armoured truck in free roam
Force it open and take the money
Escape the response to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every district, island and back road the state contains. The description sets a coverage goal rather than a checklist, and exploration accrues naturally while you chase everything else: stunts, cards, meditation spots and races all drag you into new territory. What remains at the end is usually a handful of grey corners — offshore spots, rural edges, places no objective ever visits — and a deliberate final tour with the map from the method sources closes them out. Pair this sweep with the vehicle-discovery trophy, since new areas spawn new traffic.
steps: Travel widely during the story and sweeps
Check the map for unexplored areas late in the run
Visit every remaining area until Leonida is fully explored

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang, until every gang has been hit. The description's 'each' is the discipline here: robbing your favourite gang nine times earns nothing beyond the first, so keep a written tally of which gangs are done, in this guide's checklist or on paper. Gang operations are defended, so arrive armed and leave fast; each robbery is also honest work toward the vault, truck and wanted-level trophies. The method sources identify every gang and where its operations sit if one gang proves hard to find.
steps: Identify each gang's illegal operation
Rob one operation per gang, tracking which are done
The trophy unlocks when every gang has been robbed once

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Flagged as missable in this guide, as a precaution, and here is the reasoning: the title points at the very start of the game, and a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach reads like the opening's quiet moment — the calm scene before the story's machinery takes over. The description names no mission, so it may well stay available in free roam for the whole game; but nothing in the list guarantees that, and a two-minute drink is a cheap insurance policy. The deadline is your first visit to Ocean Beach: when you get there, find the spot with the view, order the cocktail, and bank the bronze before the plot starts pulling you inland.
steps: Reach Ocean Beach at your first opportunity
Find the cocktail spot with the view
Enjoy the cocktail before moving on with the story

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The genre's oldest joke, made official: get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive out through the glass. The description asks for the exit, in 'classic style' — through the window, not the door — so pick a showroom with a car on the floor, take the wheel, and aim for the biggest pane. It is a one-off stunt rather than a repeatable grind, and showrooms sit in the commercial districts you pass constantly. If the first attempt ends in a dignified drive out of an open entrance, circle back and do it properly: glass everywhere.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a display car
Accelerate toward the window, not the exit
Smash out through the glass to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowling, at one named alley: Kolt & Associates'. The description's 'follow-through' is bowling language — roll your ball properly at this specific alley and the bronze is yours. A named location means any other alley will not do, so travel to Kolt & Associates' when you are in its part of Leonida and play. Like the arcade trophy, this doubles as an activity sample and costs only a few relaxed minutes; the method sources give the alley's location if you have somehow driven past it for forty hours.

Play bowling there
Complete your follow-through to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Another teaser description — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — which names no action, place or number, so this guide will not pretend otherwise. What the wording does establish is the theme: the partnership, the two leads whose double act runs through the whole list, from the partner wanted-level trophies to the finale. Trophies worded like this usually mark a specific scripted beat rather than a repeatable feat, so the working plan is simply to keep playing the story and the duo's shared activities, and let it pop at its moment. If it has not arrived by the credits, the method sources cited here identify the exact beat it is attached to.
steps: Keep progressing the story with both lead characters
Complete the duo's shared activities as they appear
If it has not unlocked by the finale, check the method sources for the exact beat

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Flagged as missable in this guide, for a structural reason: this trophy counts the choices you make — the list's own note puts the tracked total at 500 — and story choices are the one currency a playthrough cannot earn back, because a decision once made on a save simply stands. The practical risk is not malice but sleepwalking: skipping scenes, defaulting through prompts, or rushing dialogue and reaching the finale with the counter short and no choices left to make. Engage with every choice the game offers on your first playthrough, exactly as it is presented, and the counter fills as a by-product of actually playing the story. The deadline is the final mission — after it, unmade choices belong to a save that no longer has them.
steps: From the first chapter, engage with every choice prompt the story offers
Do not skip decision scenes on your platinum save
Let the choice counter fill across the whole campaign

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A teaser description again — 'second time's the charm' — and the honest reading is built into the phrase: something must be attempted, failed or missed, and then succeeded at on the second try. The description names no activity, so this guide will not invent one; trophies of this shape usually attach to a specific repeatable moment rather than to general play. The practical approach is to not fear failure anywhere in Leonida — retry races, ranges and challenges when you lose them, because a second-attempt success somewhere is what the trophy is watching for. If it stays silent through the sweeps, the method sources identify the exact attempt it counts.
steps: Play normally and retry activities when you fail them
Watch for the unlock on a second-attempt success
If it never pops, check the method sources for the specific attempt it tracks

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The list's mystery trophy: witness something strange. Both the name and the description — 'what the hell just happened?' — are written to be discovered rather than explained, and this guide respects that: the description establishes only that there is a strange event somewhere in Leonida to witness. Trophies of this kind reward the explorers, so it pairs naturally with the full-map exploration sweep — strange things happen at the edges of the map, at odd hours, in places no mission visits. When something inexplicable happens in front of you, stay and watch; that is the whole requirement. If curiosity outruns patience, the method sources point at the phenomenon.

When something strange occurs, stay and witness it fully
The trophy unlocks once you have seen it

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but with fists or a bat instead of a gun. The description's bowling pun is the instruction: your vehicle is the ball, the pedestrian is the pin, and the contact has to come from the melee swing, not the bumper. Roll slowly past a pedestrian on a quiet street, time the swing as you pass, and keep the speed low enough that the hit registers as melee rather than a collision. It will take a few passes to find the timing, and every attempt is free.
steps: Drive slowly alongside a pedestrian
Swing a melee attack out of the vehicle as you pass
Connect with the pedestrian to knock them down

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A money grind with a specific pipeline: earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The description separates the dirty money from clean earnings — ordinary income does not count; the bills have to be marked, which ties them to robberies, and they have to pass through your contacts to be laundered. Build the habit early: every robbery spree on this list — vaults, trucks, gang operations — can feed marked bills into the laundry, so route them through your contacts instead of letting them sit. The total is cumulative, so steady play across Stage 3 gets there without a single dedicated farming session.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and scores
Launder them through your contacts instead of spending them raw
Reach $250,000 earned through laundering

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, game-wide, and almost impossible to avoid on a platinum run. The description counts spending everywhere, so every weapon, vehicle upgrade, outfit and property-adjacent purchase moves the counter; there is no single shop to favour and no category to avoid. The only way to be slow at this trophy is to hoard, so do not: Leonida's economy rewards the money moving, and your arsenal and garage will be better for it. If you reach late game somehow short of the total, a deliberate shopping spree closes it in minutes.
steps: Spend freely in shops throughout the playthrough
Let heist income flow into weapons, vehicles and gear
Reach $100,000 total spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on Leonida's market. The description makes it a complete-the-set purchase: all of them, not a portfolio of favourites, so this trophy is really a savings goal wearing a property hat. Garages cost serious money, which is why it sits in the collectible stage but usually completes during Stage 3, once heists and robberies have filled the account. Buy them as funds allow rather than in one spree, and let each purchase also serve the vehicle-collection side of the run. The method sources list every property and price if the last garage hides.
steps: Earn money through heists, robberies and races
Purchase each garage property as it becomes affordable
The trophy unlocks when the final garage is bought

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the lightest collectible on the list. The description asks for ten registrations, so whenever you acquire a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app there and then rather than treating it as paperwork for later. Ten is a small number against the 100 vehicles the discovery trophy wants, so the two pair naturally: discover widely, register your favourites. If you reach the end of the sweeps a registration or two short, any vehicles in your garages can be registered to close the gap.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you acquire a vehicle
Register the vehicle
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered
